Make models

Declare a causal model and set structure, restrictions, parameters, and priors.

make_model()
Make a model
simplify_model() set_nodal_restrictions()
Simplify nodal types (drop interactions, impose monotonicity)
set_restrictions()
Restrict a model
set_confound()
Set confound
make_parameters() set_parameters() get_parameters()
Setting parameters
make_priors() set_priors() get_priors()
Setting priors
set_prior_distribution()
Add prior distribution draws

Inspect models

Look inside a model — components, summaries, and DAG plots.

inspect() grab()
Helpers for inspecting causal models
interpret_type()
Interpret or find position in nodal type
get_all_data_types()
Get all data types
get_event_probabilities()
Draw complete-data event probabilities
get_query_types()
Look up query types
summary(<causal_model>) print(<summary.causal_model>)
Summarizing causal models
plot_model() plot(<causal_model>)
Plots a DAG in ggplot style using a causal model input

Update models

Bayesian updating given data (Stan).

update_model()
Fit causal model using 'stan'

query_distribution()
Calculate query distribution
plot(<model_query>)
Plot model query results
